name: Steadfast Systems
tagline: Dependable support for the systems your business runs on.

copy.headline: Keep your systems running, with people who know them.
copy.lead: Tell us what you run and what worries you about it. A senior engineer at {name} reads every enquiry and replies personally.
points: Named engineers, not a ticket queue.
Support for systems we built, and ones we did not.
There is no obligation to enquire.
copy.goalLabel: What do you need looked after?
copy.goalHint: The system, what it does for you, and what concerns you.
copy.goalPlaceholder: e.g. Our customer portal is business-critical. The developer who built it has left, and when it goes down nobody knows what to do.
copy.finePrint: We ask that you do not include passwords, keys or customer data in your enquiry.
